name: 7,N,N-TMT
summary: 7,N,N-trimethyltryptamine (7,N,N-TMT or 7-TMT), also known as 7-methyl-DMT, is a serotonin receptor modulator and psychedelic drug of the tryptamine family related to dimethyltryptamine (DMT). It was first described by 1978 and was encountered online as a novel designer drug in 2024.

pharmacology.text: 7-TMT acts as an agonist of 5-HT2 receptors. In animal tests, both 7-TMT and its 5-methoxy derivative 5-MeO-7-TMT produced behavioural responses similar to those of psychedelic drugs such as DMT, but the larger 7-ethyl and 7-bromo derivatives of DMT did not produce psychedelic responses despite having higher 5-HT2 receptor affinity in vitro (cf. DOBU, DOAM).
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

summaryZh: 7,N,N-三甲基色胺是一種色胺衍生物，分子式C13H18N2，可作為5-HT2受體激動劑。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psychedelic tryptamines, can cause nausea, dilated pupils, muscle tension, a faster heartbeat, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, they can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的迷幻色胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、瞳孔放大、肌肉緊繃、心跳加快、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的迷幻色胺类药物，可能引起恶心、瞳孔放大、肌肉紧绷、心跳加快、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: It was first described by 1978 but only appeared online as a designer drug in 2024, a gap of almost fifty years between the chemistry and the market.
fact.zh: 它最早在1978年前就已被描述，卻直到2024年才以設計師藥物的形式出現在網路上，化學合成與市場之間相隔了將近五十年。
fact.zhHans: 它最早在1978年前就已被描述，却直到2024年才以设计师药物的形式出现在网络上，化学合成与市场之间相隔了将近五十年。
